name: implied-world
description: Implied World — overnight rToken research desk. Human decides. No trading.

scripts.test:sanitize: node -e "const {sanitizeText}=require('./shared/sanitize'); const o=sanitizeText('BUY NVDA and go long'); if(/BUY|SELL|LONG|SHORT/i.test(o)){console.error('FAIL',o);process.exit(1)} console.log('PASS',o);"
